description: SAIL Chart Components - Chart types and chart configuration components. Verified against docs.appian.com 26.5.

allChartFields.description: Parameters common to all chart field components. NOTE: chart fields do NOT support marginAbove/marginBelow.

label.description: Text to display as the field label

labelPosition.description: Determines where the label appears. When set to COLLAPSED, the label is hidden and space is not reserved.

instructions.description: Supplemental text about this field (displayed below the chart)

helpTooltip.description: Displays a help icon with the specified text as a tooltip (max 500 characters). Hidden when labelPosition is COLLAPSED.

showWhen.description: Determines whether the component is displayed on the interface. When false, the component is not evaluated.

accessibilityText.description: Additional text to be announced by screen readers. Used only for accessibility; produces no visible change.

chartDataSource.description: Parameters for chart data configuration. Use either categories/series OR data/config approach (not both). Scatter charts are the exception: they have no config parameter (groupings/measures go directly on the field).

data.description: Reference to a synced record type or unsynced database-backed record type, or a!recordData(), for record-powered charts.

config.description: Chart configuration function (e.g., a!columnChartConfig(), a!pieChartConfig()). Used with record data. NOT available on a!scatterChartField.

chartAxes.description: Axis configuration for charts with X and Y axes (column, bar, line, area; scatter additionally supports xAxisMin/xAxisMax)

yAxisMin.description: Minimum displayed point on the vertical axis

yAxisMax.description: Maximum displayed point on the vertical axis

xAxisStyle.description: Determines how to display the labels and axis separators for the X-axis

yAxisStyle.description: Determines how to display the labels, axis separators, and grid lines for the Y-axis

allowDecimalAxisLabels.description: Allows dependent values to display as decimal numbers instead of integers

chartDisplay.description: Common display options for charts. Exceptions: a!pieChartField has NO showLegend (use seriesLabelStyle) and its showTooltips defaults to false.

showLegend.description: Determines whether the color legend is displayed below the chart

showDataLabels.description: Determines if data values are displayed on the chart

showTooltips.description: Determines whether tooltips display the data value on hover (pie chart default is false)

allowImageDownload.description: Shows download button to save chart as image

chartRefresh.description: Auto-refresh parameters for charts with dynamic data

refreshAlways.description: Refreshes chart after every user interaction and at each refresh interval

refreshAfter.description: Refreshes chart after specified events occur

refreshInterval.description: Time-based refresh interval in minutes. Null means no automatic refresh.

refreshOnReferencedVarChange.description: Refreshes chart when variables referenced in data parameter change

refreshOnVarChange.description: Single variable or list of variables that trigger chart refresh when changed

loadDataAsync.description: Allows the interface to load without waiting for chart data. Chart displays loading indicator until data loads. Only applies when a record type is the data source.

categories.description: Text array to display on the X-axis next to each column. Required when not using data/config approach.

series.description: Array of data series created with a!chartSeries(). Multiple series create grouped or stacked bars. Required when not using data/config approach.

colorScheme.description: Color palette for chart. Accepts enumerated values or custom scheme via a!colorSchemeCustom().

stacking.description: NONE: grouped bars; NORMAL: stacked bars with values; PERCENT_TO_TOTAL: stacked bars as percentages

referenceLines.description: Array of reference lines created with a!chartReferenceLine()

a!columnChartField.description: Vertical bars for data changes over time
notes: Use categories/series OR data/config (not both)
Multiple series with stacking NONE produces grouped bars
Multiple series with stacking NORMAL produces single stacked bar per category
Record-powered charts: dataLimit default 100, max 5,000 data points
Incompatible with offline mobile, process reports, and autoscaling

series.description: Array of data slices created with a!chartSeries(). Required when not using data/config approach.

showAsPercentage.description: Displays values as percentages instead of raw numbers

showTooltips.description: Determines if a tooltip displays the data value for a pie slice. Default: false (unlike other chart types, which default to true).

style.description: PIE: full circle; DONUT: circle with center cutout

seriesLabelStyle.description: Determines where series labels are displayed

colorScheme.description: Color palette for chart. Accepts enumerated values or custom scheme via a!colorSchemeCustom().

a!pieChartField.description: Circular slices for parts of a whole
notes: Use series OR data/config (not both)
DONUT style creates ring chart with empty center
Record-powered charts: dataLimit default 100, max 5,000 data points
a!pieChartField._notes: Per Appian docs (verified 26.5), pieChartField does NOT accept showLegend despite the schema's chartDisplay inheritance. Use seriesLabelStyle: 'LEGEND' | 'ON_CHART' | 'NONE' for legend control. The inherited showDataLabels (default false) and allowImageDownload ARE accepted; showTooltips is accepted but defaults to FALSE for pie charts. There is no stacking, no axes, and no MICRO height.

categories.description: Text, Date, or Date and Time array to display on the X-axis below each data point. Sort Date/DateTime arrays before using them as categories. Required when not using data/config approach.

series.description: Array of data series created with a!chartSeries(). Each series creates a separate line. Required when not using data/config approach.

colorScheme.description: Color palette for chart. Accepts enumerated values or custom scheme via a!colorSchemeCustom().

referenceLines.description: Array of reference lines created with a!chartReferenceLine()

connectNulls.description: When true, connects points across null data values; when false, creates gaps in the line

a!lineChartField.description: Connected points for trends over time
notes: Use categories/series OR data/config (not both)
connectNulls=false creates gaps for missing data points
Record-powered charts: dataLimit default 100, max 5,000 data points

categories.description: Text array to display next to each bar. Required when not using data/config approach.

series.description: Array of data series created with a!chartSeries(). Multiple series create grouped or stacked bars. Required when not using data/config approach.

height.description: AUTO (default) adjusts height based on number of categories

colorScheme.description: Color palette for chart. Accepts enumerated values or custom scheme via a!colorSchemeCustom().

stacking.description: NONE: grouped bars; NORMAL: stacked bars with values; PERCENT_TO_TOTAL: stacked bars as percentages

referenceLines.description: Array of reference lines created with a!chartReferenceLine()

a!barChartField.description: Horizontal bars for values at same time point
notes: Use categories/series OR data/config (not both)
Bar chart is the only chart whose default height is AUTO
Record-powered charts: dataLimit default 100, max 5,000 data points

categories.description: Text, Date, or Date and Time array to display on the X-axis below each data point. Sort Date/DateTime arrays before using them as categories. Required when not using data/config approach.

series.description: Array of data series created with a!chartSeries(). Each series creates a separate shaded area. Required when not using data/config approach.

colorScheme.description: Color palette for chart. Accepts enumerated values or custom scheme via a!colorSchemeCustom().

stacking.description: NORMAL: stacked areas; PERCENT_TO_TOTAL: stacked as percentages; NONE: overlapping areas

connectNulls.description: When true, connects the area across null points; when false, renders a gap on either side of the null

referenceLines.description: Array of reference lines created with a!chartReferenceLine()

a!areaChartField.description: Area chart with shaded regions between line and axis
notes: Use categories/series OR data/config (not both)
Default stacking is NORMAL (unlike column/bar which default to NONE)
Record-powered charts: dataLimit default 100, max 5,000 data points

data.description: Reference to a synced record type or unsynced database-backed record type. Accepts a!recordData() or a record type reference. Scatter charts ONLY work with record data.

primaryGrouping.description: Defines the field labels to display on the points in the chart, configured using a!grouping()

secondaryGrouping.description: Optional second grouping configured using a!grouping(); displays a color legend when used

xAxisMeasure.description: Numerical calculation for the X-axis, configured using a!measure()

yAxisMeasure.description: Numerical calculation for the Y-axis, configured using a!measure()

sort.description: a!sortInfo() sort; use the alias of any grouping or measure, or a record field reference

dataLimit.description: Maximum number of data points to display. Default: 5000. Valid values: 1-5000 (unlike other chart configs whose default is 100).

link.description: Link to execute when a user selects a data point. Use fv!selection for selection context; create with a!dynamicLink().

xAxisMin.description: Minimum displayed point on the horizontal axis

xAxisMax.description: Maximum displayed point on the horizontal axis

yAxisMin.description: Minimum displayed point on the vertical axis

yAxisMax.description: Maximum displayed point on the vertical axis

allowDecimalAxisLabels.description: Allows values to display as decimal numbers instead of integers

referenceLines.description: Array of reference lines created with a!chartReferenceLine()

height.description: Chart height. No MICRO size for scatter charts.

colorScheme.description: Color palette for chart. Accepts enumerated values or custom scheme via a!colorSchemeCustom().

a!scatterChartField.description: Points showing relationship between two numerical values
notes: Scatter charts ONLY work with record data (recordType! reference or a!recordData) - cannot use categories/series approach
There is NO config parameter and NO a!scatterChartConfig function: set primaryGrouping, xAxisMeasure, and yAxisMeasure directly on the field
showLegend only applies when a secondaryGrouping is used
dataLimit default 5000 (max 5000)

primaryGrouping.description: Primary grouping created with a!grouping(). Determines X-axis categories.

secondaryGrouping.description: Secondary grouping created with a!grouping(). Creates grouped or stacked series.

measures.description: Array of measures created with a!measure(). If no measure is provided, a count of records is shown.

sort.description: Sort configuration created with a!sortInfo(). Use the alias of any grouping or measure, or a record field reference.

dataLimit.description: Maximum number of data points to display. Default: 100. Valid values: 1-5000.

link.description: Link to execute when chart element is clicked. Use fv!selection for selection context; create with a!dynamicLink().

showIntervalsWithNoData.description: When true, the axis displays date/time values that have no data (e.g., show February even if empty). Only available when a Date, Time, or Date and Time field is the primary grouping. Default: false.

a!columnChartConfig.description: Configuration for column chart with record data

primaryGrouping.description: Primary grouping created with a!grouping(). Determines Y-axis categories.

secondaryGrouping.description: Secondary grouping created with a!grouping(). Creates grouped or stacked series.

measures.description: Array of measures created with a!measure(). If no measure is provided, a count of records is shown.

sort.description: Sort configuration created with a!sortInfo(). Use the alias of any grouping or measure, or a record field reference.

dataLimit.description: Maximum number of data points to display. Default: 100. Valid values: 1-5000.

link.description: Link to execute when chart element is clicked. Use fv!selection for selection context; create with a!dynamicLink().

showIntervalsWithNoData.description: When true, the axis displays date/time values that have no data. Only available when a Date, Time, or Date and Time field is the primary grouping. Default: false.

a!barChartConfig.description: Configuration for bar chart with record data

primaryGrouping.description: Primary grouping created with a!grouping(). Determines X-axis categories.

secondaryGrouping.description: Secondary grouping created with a!grouping(). Creates multiple lines.

measures.description: Array of measures created with a!measure(). If no measure is provided, a count of records is shown.

sort.description: Sort configuration created with a!sortInfo(). Use the alias of any grouping or measure, or a record field reference.

dataLimit.description: Maximum number of data points to display. Default: 100. Valid values: 1-5000.

link.description: Link to execute when chart element is clicked. Use fv!selection for selection context; create with a!dynamicLink().

showIntervalsWithNoData.description: When true, the axis displays date/time values that have no data. Only available when a Date, Time, or Date and Time field is the primary grouping. Default: false.

a!lineChartConfig.description: Configuration for line chart with record data

primaryGrouping.description: Primary grouping created with a!grouping(). Determines X-axis categories.

secondaryGrouping.description: Secondary grouping created with a!grouping(). Creates multiple areas.

measures.description: Array of measures created with a!measure(). If no measure is provided, a count of records is shown.

sort.description: Sort configuration created with a!sortInfo(). Use the alias of any grouping or measure, or a record field reference.

dataLimit.description: Maximum number of data points to display. Default: 100. Valid values: 1-5000.

link.description: Link to execute when chart element is clicked. Use fv!selection for selection context; create with a!dynamicLink().

showIntervalsWithNoData.description: When true, the axis displays date/time values that have no data. Only available when a Date, Time, or Date and Time field is the primary grouping. Default: false.

a!areaChartConfig.description: Configuration for area chart with record data. Only applies when a record type is the source in the data parameter.

primaryGrouping.description: Primary grouping created with a!grouping(). Determines pie slices.

measures.description: Array of measures created with a!measure(). If no measure is provided, a count of records is shown.

sort.description: Sort configuration created with a!sortInfo(). Use the alias of any grouping or measure, or a record field reference.

dataLimit.description: Maximum number of data points to display. Default: 100. Valid values: 1-5000.

link.description: Link to execute when chart element is clicked. Use fv!selection for selection context; create with a!dynamicLink().

a!pieChartConfig.description: Configuration for pie chart with record data
notes: Pie charts do not support secondaryGrouping or showIntervalsWithNoData

a!scatterChartConfig.status: UNVERIFIED - NOT FOUND IN APPIAN DOCS
a!scatterChartConfig.description: DO NOT USE. This function does not exist in the Appian documentation (verified against 26.5, 25.4, 25.2, and 24.4 - no doc page and zero references). a!scatterChartField has NO config parameter: configure scatter charts by setting primaryGrouping, secondaryGrouping, xAxisMeasure, yAxisMeasure, sort, dataLimit, and link directly on a!scatterChartField. The previously documented xAxisField/yAxisField parameters are likewise not part of any official Appian API.
notes: Kept only as a tombstone so generators do not reinvent it; see a!scatterChartField for the correct 26.5 scatter chart API

a!colorSchemeCustom.description: Defines a custom list of colors to apply to any chart.

colors.description: List of colors to use in the custom color scheme. Valid values: any valid hex colors, optionally with two extra transparency digits (00 more transparent to FF less transparent). Maximum colors allowed: 12. Example: { "#FF0000", "#00FF00", "#0000FF" }.

a!colorSchemeCustom._notes: Use as the value of a chart's colorScheme parameter when the named schemes (CLASSIC, OCEAN, etc.) don't fit. Example: colorScheme: a!colorSchemeCustom(colors: { "#3FB8AF", "#A9D78A" }).
